argument: If every interior node has full degree 3, f^T L_ii f = sum over edges of the infinite graph of (f_a - f_b)^2 for f supported on the interior; so L_ii is the compression of the infinite Laplacian.
Rayleigh quotient: lambda_min(L_ii) = inf over interior-supported f >= inf over finitely supported f = lambda_0.
Nested interiors => lambda_min non-increasing in L; exhaustion (every finitely supported f is eventually interior-supported) => convergence to lambda_0.
lambda_0 > 0 by H2-L-0001; hence tau = C / lambda_min <= C / lambda_0 uniformly in N.
